title: Writ Record or Record-Link Judgment
description: An independent judgment about a record or a record link. A judgment carries its own `status` vocabulary (`proposed`, `accepted`, `contested`, `superseded`) which is distinct from the `review_state` of the record or record link it targets (`draft`, `reviewed`, `approved`, `superseded`, `withdrawn`). Accepting a judgment never changes the workflow state of its target.

supersedes_judgment_ids.description: Older judgments this judgment replaces. Only a judgment that was accepted can have replaced anything, so this is allowed when `status` is `accepted`, and retained when that judgment has itself since been `superseded`. A `proposed` or `contested` judgment has not replaced anything.

superseded_by_judgment_id.description: The newer judgment that replaced this one. Required when `status` is `superseded`.

$comment: Self-supersession and longer supersession cycles are cross-instance properties of a judgment set, not of a single document, so they are enforced by `validateJudgmentSupersession` in `@writ/domain` rather than by this schema.
